application_ready.activity_description_max_150_characters: Built ALPHAC: 228 retired legacy identities, 1 prospective trial, broker evidence, corrections, and 16 checksum-bound papers.
application_ready.memorable_lesson: The project became stronger when its validation system disproved attractive results; the contribution is the machinery that makes those reversals visible.
application_ready.short_description: Designed and implemented a quantitative-research and publication system spanning data engineering, statistical validation, paper execution, provenance, testing and public web interfaces. Published negative results and corrections alongside surviving hypotheses so every performance claim can be traced to evidence.

claim_boundary: This is a source-bound portfolio evidence map. It supports concise factual writing but does not prove admissions impact, external use, independent review or unaided authorship.

ai_assisted_tooling.role: Reviewed development assistance across implementation, testing, technical drafting, publication preparation and quality assurance.

arhan_canli.credit_boundary: Named authorship records responsibility. It does not prove that Arhan typed every line without assistance.
responsibilities: sets the project direction and accepts responsibility for what is published
must personally approve author answers and manuscript-specific claims
controls external submissions and responses to reviewers
must be able to explain and defend every major research and system decision
arhan_canli.role: Founder, named author, project owner and final accountable human for methodology, claims, corrections and publication decisions.

external_validation.boundary: These are local commissioning packets with blank reviewer fields. They prove no outreach, review, independent replication, submission, acceptance, or publication.

libraries_services_and_data.credit_boundary: Their use is not evidence that they endorse, reviewed or validated ALPHAC.
libraries_services_and_data.role: Open-source software, market-data providers, Alpaca paper accounts, DigitalOcean and web infrastructure supply capabilities and inputs.

not_established: independent confirmation of the contribution map

forward_truth.boundary: The forward Sharpe, drawdown and diversification objectives are not established.
forward_truth.claim: The project refuses to infer success from an immature forward record.

research_governance.boundary: Publishing an incomplete packet does not make it complete or reproducible.
research_governance.claim: Every recorded legacy identity has a public packet and unresolved debt remains visible.

scholarly_objects.boundary: Archive integrity is not result replay or rights clearance; no DOI, external submission, peer review or independent replication is claimed.
scholarly_objects.claim: Each sleeve has an authored archival research object and evidence bundle.

statistical_judgment.boundary: Targets are objectives, not achieved results; legacy trials cannot be regraded.
statistical_judgment.claim: Admission v7 separates incremental decisions from portfolio-maturity claims.

systems_and_provenance.boundary: Alpaca accounts are paper accounts; broker reconciliation is not funded performance.
systems_and_provenance.claim: Broker and publication claims are connected to hash-bound evidence.

testing_and_correctness.boundary: Mutation coverage applies to the enumerated published-claim guards, not every program path.
testing_and_correctness.claim: Published-claim guards were mutation-tested with a negative control.

chapters.label: The question
chapters.narration: Most quant projects publish the winning curve. I wanted to know whether the evidence could stay public even when it proved me wrong.

chapters.label: Freeze the attempt
chapters.narration: ALPHAC records every attempt before judging it. The public union now contains 228 legacy identities and one prospective identity, including failures and incomplete packets.

chapters.label: Keep the reversal
chapters.narration: When a flattering result breaks, the system keeps the original claim, the defect, the correction and the test that prevents the same mistake.

chapters.label: Observe the broker
chapters.narration: Three dedicated Alpaca paper accounts reconcile against the published record. They contain no client capital and prove no funded performance.

chapters.label: Publish the proof
chapters.narration: A signed append-only record connects public claims to artifacts and corrections. Verification proves integrity, not that the strategy will win.

chapters.label: End with the burden
chapters.narration: The forward record has only 17 daily observations, external reviews remain at zero, and Foundry is planned not applied. The open burden is part of the result.

ninety_second_walkthrough.claim_boundary: This is a timed production script and evidence path. It is not a recorded video, proof that a viewer watched it or evidence of admissions impact.

one_sentence_thesis: Arhan Canli built ALPHAC to test whether quantitative-finance claims can be made publicly falsifiable through point-in-time data, complete trial accounting, broker reconciliation, deterministic evidence and visible corrections.
what_not_to_claim: that automation proves Arhan's unaided personal contribution
